chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning a man who kills his slave by mistake, he said:
He must free a slave, fast for two months, and give charity to sixty poor persons. If he is unable to free a slave, then fasting is upon him; and if he is unable to fast, then charity is upon him.

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charity, required here when fasting is not possible
key_terms.الصِّيَامُ: fasting, required here when freeing a slave is not possible
key_terms.سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا: sixty poor persons who are to receive charity
key_terms.صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ: fasting for two months as kaffarah

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for accidentally killing one's slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the legal ruling for one who kills his slave by mistake. It establishes an expiation consisting of freeing a slave, fasting for two months, and feeding sixty poor persons, with alternatives applied according to ability.
